verdict.rationale: The docs show ways to prototype without paying up front: $400 in free trial credits on CockroachDB Standard, Basic clusters whose Request Unit consumption scales to zero when idle, and free local `cockroach demo` and single-node clusters for app development. However, no perpetual free tier with documented limits is evidenced, and community reports note that free users need an annual license key and that features like backup/restore were once enterprise-only. missing for 10: an explicitly documented always-free cloud tier with stated quotas, independent confirmation that free usage is enough for real prototypes, clarity on which features the free license gates.

support.subject: As a founder, a genuinely usable free tier lets me run real prototypes before paying

citations.quote: it will be credited with $400 in to get you started
